title: The Heart's Journey - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Heart's Journey trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Heart's Journey phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The first trophy in the game and the one nobody can miss. It doubles as the moment the red and blue attack flashes are taught.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the Prologue - escape the pursuers on the Main Road.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
